title: Tantei wa mou, Shindeiru. Season 2

thread.title: The Detective is Already Dead Season 2 • Tantei wa Mou, Shindeiru. Season 2 - Episode 6 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters enjoyed the episode and considered it notably good or enjoyable.
Character interactions and the cast’s continuing development were received favorably, with particular interest in Olivia, the Priestess, and the returning characters.
Some viewers were engaged by the episode’s mysteries and character revelations, while others mainly expressed uncertainty or said they had forgotten relevant earlier details.

The thread itself had very low engagement, and one commenter linked that lack of activity to the show’s long gap and weak first-season reception; no clear substantive negative critique of this episode’s animation, pacing, or sound was present.
